appearance.title: Theme and language
appearance.intro: Operator appearance preferences (also available in the status bar).

projectionTypography.title: Projection typography
projectionTypography.intro: Configure font, size and shadow of projected text for each output. Changes apply to projection clients within about one second.
projectionTypography.fontSourceSystemWarning: System fonts depend on the projecting device. Tablets or remote PCs may not have the same font installed.
projectionTypography.minMaxHint: On real output the text grows up to the largest size that fits the usable area.
projectionTypography.minMaxError: Minimum cannot be greater than maximum.
projectionTypography.textfillHint: Shrinks or grows the font to avoid scroll and clipping. Off uses fixed maximum size.
projectionTypography.textShadowDisabledHint: Flat text, no outline or shadow.
projectionTypography.shadowAdvancedHint: For experienced users only. Invalid CSS will be ignored.
projectionTypography.shadowAdvancedError: Could not apply this CSS. Check the syntax.

preview.title: Preview
preview.footnote: Preview: text fits in this area. On {destination} the font may be larger.

worship.title: Worship and stanzas
worship.intro: How long verses are split in the projection queue and Songs panel list.
worship.maxEstofreLinesHint: Verses with more lines are split into blocks (default 4). E.g. 8 lines → two blocks of 4; 9 lines → 4+5. Does not change lyrics stored in the database. Remove and re-add songs already in the queue to apply a new value.

bible.title: Bible and search
bible.intro: Recent reference history in the Bible panel search field.
bible.searchHistoryLimitHint: Maximum recent references shown as shortcuts (default 5).

users.title: Users
users.intro: Accounts for remote access and local operator. Password or role changes invalidate active sessions.

backup.panelIntro: Export or import the Live Praise environment (database, media, themes and preferences). Administrators only. Use when moving computers or recovering after a failure.
backup.backupIntro: Choose what to include in the .zip file. Unchecked items are not included in the backup.
backup.restoreIntro: Select a backup (.zip) generated by this system. You can only restore groups present in that file.
backup.restorePrivacyNote: Restore replaces selected data on this computer. Confirm the file came from a trusted source.
backup.privacyBody: This file contains your church data. If the database is included, it also carries usernames and credentials (encrypted passwords). Store it securely, only on trusted devices, and delete it when no longer needed. Do not email it or store in public cloud without additional encryption.
backup.privacyUnencryptedWarning: This backup is not password-protected. Anyone with access to the file may attempt to recover operator accounts.
backup.manifestSummary: Backup from {date} · Version {appVersion} · {groupCount} groups in file
backup.databaseReloginWarning: After restoring the database, all operators must sign in again.
backup.overwriteBody: The following groups already exist on this computer and will be replaced: {groups}.
backup.overwriteAcknowledge: I understand selected data will be replaced
backup.reloginRequired: For security, all sessions were ended. Sign in again before continuing to operate.
backup.globalBanner: Maintenance: backup or restore in progress. Some actions are temporarily unavailable.

repertoire.title: Song repertoire (JSON)
repertoire.intro: Export or import only songs, categories and stanzas as a JSON file — useful for sharing repertoire between churches. This is separate from the full-environment .zip backup.

groups.databaseHint: Includes operator accounts and encrypted credentials.
groups.mediaVideosHint: Large files — generation may take several minutes.
groups.errorLogHint: May contain sensitive technical details. Unchecked by default.
groups.operatorUiHint: State saved on this computer, not in the livepraise folder.

errors.failed: Could not complete the operation. Please try again.
errors.diskFull: Insufficient disk space to create backup.
errors.permissionDenied: No permission to write to the chosen destination.
errors.migrationNewer: This backup is from a newer Live Praise version. Update the app before restoring.

errorLog.title: Error logs
errorLog.intro: Recent server errors and API failures in the operator interface.
errorLog.confirmClear: Clear all error records? This action cannot be undone.
errorLog.displayDebugOverlayHint: When active, shows the last received action in the footer of projection monitors and network-connected devices (e.g. song change at 5:08:38 PM).

shortcuts.title: Keyboard shortcuts
shortcuts.intro: Redefine the combinations below. If two actions use the same key, the system warns immediately. Changes are saved on this computer like other operator preferences.

preview.hint: Suggested flow: choose category, then song and stanza — in a few clicks. Preferences are saved automatically on this computer.

tabs.empty: Empty queue — drag items from panels or create a blank queue (+)
tabs.missingSong: Song not found in this database — file lyrics kept; you may remove the tab (×).
tabs.dropHint: Drag stanzas, Bible, images or videos to this queue — or drop on a tab above.

queueAdd.title: Add to queue
queueAdd.intro: Choose how to import images or videos into this queue.
queueAdd.localHint: Files are copied to the local library. Non-MP4 videos are converted automatically.
queueAdd.mediaUrlHint: Cole o link direto do ficheiro (PNG, JPG, MP4…). O servidor descarrega para a biblioteca local. Não use links com login ou páginas web. Evite URLs com palavras-passe ou tokens na query.
queueAdd.mediaUrlResultDownload: File imported to local library. Item is already in the queue.
queueAdd.mediaUrlResultReference: Item added with remote link. If projection fails, the file server may block the browser (CORS) — prefer local import when possible.
queueAdd.mediaUrlDoneHint: Item was added to the queue. Close when you have read the result above.
queueAdd.youtubeHint: Video enters the queue immediately. Local download tries once if the video is protected; if download starts and is interrupted, retries up to 3 times. Track progress on the queue card.
queueAdd.resultLocal: Video downloaded to local library (local mode). Item is already in the queue.
queueAdd.resultOnline: Could not download; item will play online. Also logged in Settings → Error log (source youtube-import).
queueAdd.youtubeDoneHint: Item was added to the queue. Close when you have read the result above.

errors.mediaUrlRequired: Enter the image or video URL.
errors.mediaUrlUseYoutube: This link is from YouTube. Use «Import YouTube video» in the previous menu.
errors.mediaUrlSsrf: Address not allowed. Use a public internet link (https://).
errors.mediaUrlUnsupported: Address is not a supported image or video.
errors.mediaUrlTooLarge: File too large (max. 50 MB image, 600 MB video).
errors.mediaUrlTimeout: Download took too long. Try another link or smaller file.
errors.mediaUrlSsl: Secure connection failed. Confirm the site uses valid HTTPS.
errors.serverOutdated: Importação indisponível no servidor (HTTP 404). Feche o Live Praise, libere a porta 3000 (processos node/electron antigos), execute npm run build com Node 22+ (nvm use) e npm run dev. Confirme GET /health → features.cad194:true e GET /video/importar/ping → cad194:true.

newSong.title: New song
newSong.name: Name
newSong.lyricsHint: Separate each stanza with a blank line between them.

actions.playlistExportEmpty: Queue is empty — add songs before exporting.

serviceTimer.title: Service counter / timer
serviceTimer.intro: Choose per monitor whether to show count-up (counter) or count-down (timer). You can have counter on stage return and timer on projector at the same time.
serviceTimer.targetsHint: Check screens that should show the overlay. On each row choose Counter (counts up from zero) or Timer (counts down to zero).
serviceTimer.noTargets: No projection or return monitor configured. Set roles in Settings → Projector screen.

footerAlert.title: Footer alert
footerAlert.intro: Sends scrolling text in the bottom bar of selected monitors. Text scrolls across the screen the set number of times at the set speed.
footerAlert.textPlaceholder: E.g. Prayer service at 8 PM — room 2
footerAlert.targetsHint: All checked = send to all projection, return and connected device screens. Uncheck to restrict.
footerAlert.noTargets: No monitor configured. Set roles in Settings → Projector screen.

about.title: About Live Praise
about.whatIsBody: Live Praise is projection software for churches and services. It displays song lyrics, Bible verses, images and videos on the projector, with real-time operator control and remote monitor support over the network.
about.licenseBody: This software is distributed under the MIT license. You may use, copy, modify, merge, publish, distribute, sublicense and/or sell copies of the software, provided the copyright notice and permission above are included in all copies or relevant portions.
about.licenseDisclaimer: The software is provided "as is", without warranties of any kind.
stackItems: Node.js, Express 5 and WebSocket (ws) on the server
about.runtime: Runtime for this installation: Node.js {node}, Chromium {chromium}, Electron {electron}.

screenSize.title: Projection screen size
screenSize.hint: Choose the aspect ratio or pixel dimensions of the projection area on screen.
screenSize.perMonitorHint: Each «Projection» monitor can have a different size — use the gear on the monitor row. Remote computers at /projector appear in «Remote projectors».
screenSize.contentFitHint: Defines what to do when image or video resolution is lower than the projection area.
screenSize.livePreview: Preview on projector while changing (before applying)
screenSize.saved: Screen size saved and sent to projector.

remoteProjection.none: No remote projector connected. Open http://server:port/projector on the remote computer.

external.hint: Network-connected devices (live, vocal, stage return or musicians) appear here and in the status bar.
